title: xantophtalmum coronarium
intro: Xantophtalmum coronarium, commonly known as Yellow Crown Daisy, is a flowering plant species native to South Africa. It is valued for its potential health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, and has been traditionally used to treat various conditions such as fever, cough, and respiratory issues. The plant's therapeutic actions are attributed to its bioactive constituents, which include flavonoids, terpenoids, and phenolic compounds that exhibit anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antiviral activities. The bioactive constituents in Xantophtalmum coronarium, such as flavonoids and terpenoids, are also believed to possess antioxidant and anti-cancer properties.
